_note: Register lean-computer-use as an MCP server. The exact schema depends on the client: zcode nests servers under mcp.servers, Claude Desktop uses a top-level mcpServers object. Replace <PROJECT_DIR> and <PYTHON> with real paths.

generic_http._note: Some clients want a stdio wrapper script instead of a direct command; run 'lean-computer-use serve' and point the client at it. Vision config lives in ~/.lean-cu/config.json and is never part of the client config.
